overview.title: Executive Overview
overview.description: High-level aggregate customer health, ARR risk distribution, top signals, and recommended actions queue.
components: KPI Cards Row (Total ARR, Portfolio Health Index, ARR At Risk, Expansion Pipeline)
Health Distribution Chart (Donut + Stacked Segment Bar)
ARR At Risk vs Expansion Opportunity Summary Widget
Top AI Intelligence Signals Feed
High Priority Actions Quick Action Queue

customers.title: Customer Directory & Portfolio
customers.description: Filterable and sortable list of all enterprise B2B customer accounts.
components: Multi-select Filter Bar (Health Status, ARR Range, Renewal Window, Segment, CSM)
Filter Chips Bar with Clear All option
Data Table with columns: Account Name, Industry, ARR, Health Score, License Utilization, Active Users, Renewal Date, Priority Badge, Quick Action button
Pagination & Results Counter

customer_360.title: Customer 360 Degree View
customer_360.description: Deep-dive analytical drill-down into an individual B2B customer account.
components: Customer Header Banner (Logo, Name, Industry, ARR, CSM, Contract Dates, Health Badge)
Health Score Trend Line (12-month historical trend)
Udemy-style Product Adoption Breakdown (Course completions, active learner seats, top departments)
License Utilization Seat Bar (Allocated vs Active vs Assigned)
Stakeholder & Account Contacts Matrix
Evidence-backed Insight Cards Stream

adoption.title: Adoption & Product Utilization
adoption.description: Granular metrics on product usage patterns, DAU/WAU/MAU ratios, and learning content adoption.
components: DAU / WAU / MAU Engagement Ratio Line Chart
Seat Utilization vs Contracted Capacity Bar Chart
Feature Adoption & Course Category Heatmap
Inactive License Risk List

health_renewal.title: Health & Renewal Analytics
health_renewal.description: Risk detection and renewal timeline forecasting.
components: Scatter Plot: Health Score (X-axis) vs License Utilization % (Y-axis) with quadrants
Renewal Timeline Buckets (0-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, 90+ Days)
Risk Drivers Breakdown (Executive departure, usage drop, support ticket spike)
Renewal Risk Matrix Table

growth.title: Growth & Expansion Intelligence
growth.description: Identifying upsell, cross-sell, and seat expansion opportunities.
components: Expansion Opportunity Pipeline Summary
License Cap Threshold Alerts (Accounts at >90% license capacity)
Course/Skill Expansion Signals
Estimated Opportunity ARR Potential Cards

actions.title: Action Center & Playbooks
actions.description: Prioritized workflow queue for Customer Success and Sales teams.
components: Action Queue Filter (Status: Open/In Progress/Closed, Priority: High/Med/Low)
Action Detail Drawer / Modal (Core flow: What happened -> Why -> Evidence -> Business Impact -> Recommended Playbook Action)
Action Owner Assignment & Due Date Controls

steps: 1. Raw Data (Logins, course completes, seat assignments, support tickets)
3. Signals (25% drop in weekly active learners, executive sponsor change)
4. Insights (High churn probability before Q3 renewal)
5. Risks / Opportunities (ARR at risk: $120K / Expansion potential: $45K)
6. Why + Evidence (Key department stopped logging in 3 weeks ago; license usage dropped from 85% to 42%)
7. Recommended Action (Schedule Executive QBR & send tailored manager engagement report)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdown items, table rows, tab triggers, filter chips, action drawers, chart containers) MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cohesive React application for ALI – Customer Intelligence Platform with the 7 key navigation views.
Follow the semantic status color system strictly: Green (Healthy), Amber (Monitor), Red (At Risk), Indigo (Expansion).
Ensure data tables are sortable, filterable, searchable, and paginated with filter chips.
Implement the full evidence-backed intelligence flow in drill-down cards and drawers (What happened -> Why -> Evidence -> Business Impact -> Recommended Action).
Ensure all interactive components include data-testid attributes for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop centered layouts; stick to clean enterprise B2B grid architectures.
Ensure high text legibility and strict APCA/WCAG contrast ratios.
Use generous card padding (p-5 or p-6) and clear border definitions.
Provide interactive micro-states on cards, hover lifts, and transition states for button presses.
Always set data-testid attributes on key navigation and interactive elements.
